svg.title: FNC Power wiring diagram
svg.desc: 24V orange and GND black supply the KinCony DM4. A blue and white normally open push button connects digital IN4 to input GND. OUT4 supplies a violet 0-10V dimming signal with black signal ground. Mains L, N and PE feed the 24V DC supply, which powers the DM4 and LED dimmer. The 24V and GND distribution branches are integrated into supply panel 1. Grey GND Dimmed is a separate net shown as short labelled stubs. All dimmer inputs are on the left; its outputs are on the right.

g.text: Functional connections - not physical terminal positions
